# apexv1project

## Vision
A minimal APEX v1 project: the fixture ape's live gates run sessions against.

## Users
ape's own make targets (check-hooks, check-task-subagents, check-framework).

## Scope
Nothing but the v1 layout `ape project init` makes, plus one milestone.

## Out of scope
Product code.

## Constraints
Stays a valid v1 project: `ape project check` exits 0.

## Stack
None.
